title: Insane Detail! 🇦🇺 Blue Mountains Canyon Run | MSFS 2024 Australia Update
description:
The new Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 World Update 21: Australia is finally here, and it has completely transformed the Blue Mountains.  

In today’s flight, we’re pushing the limits of the new photogrammetry and TIN surface texturing by dropping into the deep gorges and getting up close with the iconic sandstone cliffs. The sharpness of the rock formations is genuinely incredible compared to previous versions, though I have some thoughts on how the tree quality holds up when you're this close to the ground!

What we cover in this flight:

- Low-Altitude Navigation: Flying "in-between" the peaks for a jet-fighter feel.
- Scenery Analysis: Testing the level of detail (LOD) on the cliff faces.
- VFR Immersion: Why the Blue Mountains are a must-fly destination in 2026.

Whether you're a bush pilot or just here for the "digital tourism," this update sets a new standard for Australian scenery.

What do you think of the new tree assets vs. the cliff detail? Let me know in the comments!
